venue_reasoning.downtown_koi_counter: $, sushi, no peanuts, a whole meat-free roll section, no milk/cream/cream cheese. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on rolls and peanut sauce with every set. Breaks the allergy, so it's out.
venue_reasoning.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, even the garden roll and the miso. No vegetarian option, so it's out.
venue_reasoning.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and creamy mayo on nearly everything, veggie rolls too. Fails the dairy intolerance: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over budget, otherwise fine: 2 stars.

notes: Fair, and clear once you read it. Mina plays down her own need ('i'm easy... rice and edamame'), which is a nice trap, but Maya says it straight out right after ('you're vegetarian') and Cyrus and Mina back her up, so it is hard to miss. Maybe too well signposted. Cedar Line's card shows $$, and its review says 'a clear step up in price', so the price trap is obvious too. Each decoy fails on exactly one thing, so ruling them out is quick. Nothing contradicts anything else. Roxy's 'too hot for anything warm' only points to sushi, which every venue serves, so it doesn't change the pick.
